plan.title: BOQ context across conversion and new version

steps.note: Convert the RFQ and follow the newly opened creation screen.
Assert that conversion reaches a ready creation screen.
Check the required BOQ URL contract; the supplied non-BOQ-confirmed fixture may fail this prerequisite-dependent assertion.
Check that the ordinary line-item management control is absent; this alone does not prove a BOQ grid exists.
Record the destination grid for manual BOQ-tab verification.
Return to the original prepared event rather than act on the converted event.
Start the original RFQ's new-version flow.
Assert that new-version creation reaches a ready creation screen.
Check that the new-version destination retains the required BOQ URL parameter.
Check that ordinary line-item management is not offered on the new-version screen.
Record the second destination for manual verification of BOQ grid tabs.
